contract: Explicitly allowed external Markdown vaults register through the existing canonical Knowledge source registry. Live files remain owner-controlled sources while bounded scans index canonical Knowledge items, and all explicit mutations use contained paths, immutable request receipts, expected hashes and atomic replacement.
acceptance: Register only existing directories whose resolved identity is within captured configuration knowledge.external_vault_roots; deduplicate real paths and refuse home drift.
Validate forward-slash Markdown paths, realpath every target or existing parent, skip operational folders and refuse symlink files, symlink escapes, traversal, hidden paths and absolute paths.
Scan at most 5000 notes and 64 MiB into existing Knowledge source and item tables with exact source/path identity, tags, folders, wikilinks and canonical item links; no parallel note datastore.
Archive canonical references when owner files disappear or are explicitly deleted and never recreate absent external files during scan.
Read returns the live content hash; create, update and delete use immutable request replay and current expected_hash so concurrent external edits return409 without byte loss.
Write same-directory atomic replacements with fsync, preserve vault files when registration is disabled, and derive search plus resolved/unresolved graph edges from current indexed notes.
Native tools, actual HTTP endpoints and real DOM journeys exercise registration, scan, read, search, graph, atomic write, conflict refusal and root-policy rejection.
remaining_limits: Allowed roots are operator-configured filesystem authority; hosted adaptation must use allocation-owned Connections and cannot accept arbitrary customer host paths.
This task indexes local materialized Markdown. Cloud-provider hydration, proprietary vault formats and non-Markdown attachments remain external adapter responsibilities.
Search is bounded literal matching over current indexed vault notes; canonical Knowledge retrieval remains available through the indexed item links.
Central handler registration and shared Knowledge navigation are integrated by the root lane.

verification.note: Runtime source and test hashes are unchanged from the retained 58-test pass. The final UI journey waits for allowed-root readiness, then exercises the actual outside-root rejection and confirms no registration was created.
